verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists '83(b) generation' as an included feature, so the product itself covers one of the three named compliance items. Nothing in the evidence addresses Rule 701 disclosure-threshold tracking or Form 3921 filings, and nothing shows how 83(b) generation is driven from the cap table. Missing for 10: Rule 701 threshold tracking, Form 3921 generation/filing, documented detail on automatic 83(b) generation from cap table data, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically
